about_short_description.short_description: Banque du Caire is a banking company that specializes in providing BDC online banking, phone banking, and mobile banking app.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts and Savings
product.description: Deposit products for individuals, including current accounts, savings accounts, and specialized accounts for financial inclusion, microbusinesses, and U.S. dollar savings.

product.name: Personal Loans and Consumer Finance
product.description: Financing for personal needs, including personal loans, auto loans, mortgage finance, educational loans, solar power loans, and financing for selected recreational vehicles and watercraft.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking services for managing accounts, transactions, transfers, cheque-book requests, and other banking activities through digital channels.

product.name: QaheraCash
product.description: Digital wallet services for consumers and merchants, supporting electronic payments and related financial transactions through mobile devices.

product.name: Debit, Credit, and Prepaid Cards
product.description: Payment cards for cash access, purchases, credit facilities, and prepaid spending, including Mastercard and Meeza card options.

product.name: Certificates and Time Deposits
product.description: Term-based deposit products that provide returns at maturity, at scheduled frequencies, or upfront, together with certificates of deposit.
